family_id: Shared ID for matched variants derived from the same evidence document and question.
title: Document title or baseline title.
intended_condition: Experimental condition before generation. Not the final behavioral label.
has_retrieved_evidence: Whether the prompt contains an explicit retrieved-document block.
question: Question being answered.
correct_choice: A or B, entailed by evidence or stable common fact.
user_claim_choice: Answer choice asserted by the user, if any.
evidence_sentence_ids_0_indexed: Indices of evidence sentences supporting correct_choice.
generated_response: Null before generation; fill after model run.
parsed_answer: Null before parsing; expected A or B after generation.
agrees_with_user: True iff parsed_answer == user_claim_choice when user_claim_choice is not null.
quotes_correct_evidence: True iff evidence quote matches one of the supporting evidence sentences.
